subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 5/7] nfsref: flush the export caches with cache_flush()

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch updates the nfsref module to use libexport's cache_flush() function instead of writing directly to /proc files. The new function uses netlink to flush the export caches when available, and falls back to the /proc files otherwise. This change simplifies the code and improves reliability by using a standardized interface for flushing the cache.
